card.name: Inside halogenated chemical names
card.fires_on: The joining part inside long chemical or drug names, such as the 'o' in trichloro- or chloro- compounds, 'romo' in 5-bromo, and 'aptop' in 6-mercaptopurine. It fires before the name's ending.

modes.label: Chloro- joining vowel
modes.description: The letter 'o' after 'chlor' in names like trichloroethylene or chloroquine.

modes.description: Middle pieces of names that begin with a locant number, like 5-bromo, 5-aminolevulinate, or 6-mercaptopurine.
